tools.description: Unlock the Bitwarden vault. Takes no parameters. Prompts the user for their master password through a native OS dialog; the password is never exposed to the MCP protocol or the LLM. Not supported in headless or non-interactive environments — run "bw unlock --raw" manually and set BW_SESSION in that case.
